scoring_justification: The verifier cannot re-run DFT calculations; the head-line quantity is a single numeric value produced by the agent's heavy compute. Scoring compares the agent's reported band gap against the paper's computed value with a tolerance to accommodate legitimate toolchain variation.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference direct band gap of Cs4[Ho26Cd7Se48] from DFT (PBE functional)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and Fig. S7: 'calculated band structure suggests an Eg value of 1.67 eV'. The value is the direct gap from VASP PBE calculation on the experimental crystal structure (CCDC 2034252).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published manuscript.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the paper's own computed value; using it as gold tests whether the agent can reproduce the same result with an equivalent plane-wave PBE calculation, within expected code/pseudopotential spread.
